current_answer: As checked on October 13, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found in the checked sources. Rockstar’s October 8 radio and podcast announcement adds game detail, not proof that the build is finished. No native PC version, date, or window has been announced. Xbox has ruled out the reported exclusive and PC-streaming route; other cloud service and device support remains unspecified.
